rooms.name: Immortal Map Room of the Plains
rooms.desc:
You are in the immortal map room of the great plains. There are two maps here,
one for the west called map1 and one for the east called map2.

rooms.name: The Foothills of the Grey Mountains
rooms.desc:
Dark hills, sparsely covered with stunted trees, rise out of the Plains of
dor-Sefrith, the vanguard of the forbidding Grey Mountains.  Sheer cliffs block
any possible path to the north and west, to the east are more foothills, and 
south the hills slowly blend into the plains.

rooms.name: The Plains
rooms.desc:
You stand on the edge of the vast, rolling plains of dor-Sefrith. Ankle to knee 
high grass bends gently in the wind and the air is warm and humid. Looking out 
across the plains you can see for some distance. The horizon wavers hazily in 
the heat. To the north, you can see the foothills and peaks of a mountain 
range. Plains surround you to the south as far as you can see.

You stand on the edge of the vast, rolling plains of dor-Sefrith. Ankle to knee 
high grass bends gently in the wind and the air is warm and humid. Looking out 
across the plains you can see for some distance. The horizon wavers hazily in 
the heat. To the north, you can see the foothills and peaks of a mountain 
range. Plains surround you to the south as far as you can see.
